headline: Kinder Morgan (KMI) Could Be 9% Undervalued As Bond Issues And Q2 Results Land
summary: Why Kinder Morgan stock is in focus after fresh bond issues and Q2 results Kinder Morgan (KMI) has just completed two fixed income offerings totaling about US$1.7b and reported second quarter 2026 results, putting its capital structure and earnings profile in the spotlight for stock investors. See our latest analysis for Kinder Morgan. At a share price of US$32.18, Kinder Morgan has seen mixed short term trading, with a 1 day share price return of 1.64% and some recent weekly softness...
